checks.quote: same titer
checks.reason: Matching groups does not specify functional viral dose, volume, expression interval or an executable preparation/calibration-to-choice procedure.

checks.quote: reliably silences
checks.reason: No quantitative physiological/calibration accuracy acceptance and no independent behavioral tracking reference/error criterion.

checks.quote: proportion correct choices
checks.reason: Primary denominator, omissions and missing/corrupted tracking/event outcomes are not specified.

checks.quote: if the Q-time effect survives covariate adjustment
checks.reason: Conditioning on post-treatment speed/latency does not identify a retrieval effect; it can induce selection/mediator bias. No causal assumptions justify the matching/adjustment claim.

checks.quote: Q neuron activity
checks.reason: Generic Q firing suppression does not establish selective P-to-Q transmission block. R-terminal negative results cannot rule out Q-triggered antidromic effects without matched propagation validation.

checks.quote: # Optogenetic Test: Is P→Q Necessary During Cue Retrieval?

checks.quote: # Optogenetic Test: Is P→Q Necessary During Cue Retrieval?

checks.quote: no significant effect on accuracy/latency
checks.reason: The conjunction of significant active and nonsignificant controls does not establish negligible confounds; no equivalence/meaningful-effect bounds define the decision.

checks.quote: if both converge, antidromic artifact is unlikely
checks.reason: Agreement with soma silencing can reflect the same wider-P/collateral disruption. It is not an independent test ruling out that artifact.
